```yaml
name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          label: potential-duplicate
          exclude: ""
          threshold: "0.9"
          comment: >
            Potential duplicates found:
            {{#issues}}
            - [#{{ number }}] {{ title }}
            {{/issues}}
```

name: Duplicate Issue Detection

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-duplicates:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for potential duplicates
        uses: wow-actions/potential-duplicates@v1
        with:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          label: potential-duplicate
          exclude: ""
          threshold: "0.9"
          comment: >
            Potential duplicates found:
            {{#issues}}
            - [#{{ number }}] {{ title }}
            {{/issues}}
